# BuildMax Name and Logo

The BuildMax source code is available under the [Apache License 2.0](../LICENSE).
That license does not grant trademark rights.

You may use the name "BuildMax" in a truthful, customary way to identify an
unmodified BuildMax distribution or to state that your product interoperates
with BuildMax. Do not use the name or logo in a way that implies endorsement,
ownership, sponsorship, or an official relationship.

If you distribute a modified version, use a distinct name and clearly describe
it as a modified BuildMax distribution. Do not present that distribution as an
official BuildMax release.

This document is a project naming guideline, not a statement that any mark is
registered in a particular jurisdiction. The project maintainers may update it
as the project and its trademark program mature.
